svg.text: A runnable Ktor 3 sample for SqsConsumer, manual ack/nack, retry-once redelivery, and observable queue routes.

g.text: Routes expose both queue operations and consumer evidence.
SuspendedJobTester and polling checks prove route and consumer behavior.

svg.text: Use this module to copy the SQS consumer wiring and to inspect ack, nack, interceptor, and observer outcomes through HTTP routes.
